stages.name: node_ordinals
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","kind","ordinal" FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,kind,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal FROM (SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_1) WHERE parent_kind IN ('conditional_expression','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter','typed_parameter'))

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","__start","__end","kind","text","line","parent_start","parent_end","parent_kind","ancestor_start","ancestor_end","ancestor_kind","name_start","name_source","left_start","left_end","left_kind","right_start","right_end","right_kind","right_source","type_start","type_end","type_kind","function_start","function_end","function_kind","object_start","object_end","object_kind","object_source","attribute_start","attribute_source","body_start","body_end","body_kind","parameters_start","parameters_end","parameters_kind","condition_start","condition_end","condition_kind","subject_start","subject_end","subject_kind","alias_source","module_name_start","module_name_source","id","parent","edge_parent","ordinal" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.kind||':'||n.__start||':'||n.__end AS id,
 n.parent_kind||':'||n.parent_start||':'||n.parent_end AS parent,
 n.ancestor_kind||':'||n.ancestor_start||':'||n.ancestor_end AS edge_parent,o.ordinal
 FROM (SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_1) n LEFT JOIN node_ordinals o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.__start=n.__start AND o.__end=n.__end AND o.kind=n.kind)

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT "__path","src","dst" FROM (SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL)

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start","body_start","body_end","body_kind","parameters_start","parameters_end","parameters_kind","id","name" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition')

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id","fn","cls" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned)

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end","id","name" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition')

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind","id","attr","object_text" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute')

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text","line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "right_source","id","callee_id","full_callee","callee" FROM (SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call')

stages.name: descendant_roots
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id" FROM (SELECT __path,id FROM (WITH RECURSIVE roots(__path,id) AS (SELECT __path,id FROM nodes WHERE kind='type' OR kind='assignment' AND type_start IS NOT NULL OR kind='function_definition' AND (name_source='require_sql_physical_conditional' OR name_source='compile_sql_conditional_step' OR name_source='compile' AND rx_matches(__path,'(?:^|/)l2070_batching/conditional_step\.py$')) UNION SELECT __path,left_kind||':'||left_start||':'||left_end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('assignment','for_statement') UNION SELECT __path,condition_kind||':'||condition_start||':'||condition_end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('if_statement','elif_clause') UNION SELECT __path,subject_kind||':'||subject_start||':'||subject_end FROM nodes WHERE kind='match_statement' UNION SELECT child.__path,child.id FROM nodes parent JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=parent.__path AND child.parent=parent.id AND child.ordinal=1 WHERE parent.kind='conditional_expression') SELECT __path,id FROM roots) WHERE __path IS NOT NULL AND id IS NOT NULL)

reachability.edges: WITH RECURSIVE demanded(__path,id) AS (SELECT __path,id FROM descendant_roots UNION SELECT d.__path,e.dst FROM demanded d CROSS JOIN edges e ON e.__path=d.__path AND e.src=d.id) SELECT e.__path,e.src,e.dst FROM demanded d CROSS JOIN edges e ON e.__path=d.__path AND e.src=d.id

stages.name: returns
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "right_source","value","expr_text","fn" FROM (SELECT n.*,v.id AS value,v.kind AS expr_kind,v.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='return_statement')

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end","type_start","id","target","target_text","value","expr_kind","expr_text","fn" FROM (SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('assignment','augmented_assignment'))

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","name","annotation" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_kind||':'||p.type_start||':'||p.type_end AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_kind||':'||f.parameters_start||':'||f.parameters_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND (n.id=p.id AND p.kind='identifier' OR n.parent=p.id AND n.ordinal=0 AND n.kind='identifier')
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter'))

stages.name: module_names
stages.query: SELECT "__path","qualified" FROM (SELECT __path,replace(rx_extract(__path,'(?:^|/)((?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/.*)\.py$',1),'/','.') AS qualified FROM nodes WHERE kind='module' AND rx_matches(__path,'(?:^|/)(?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/') UNION SELECT __path,rx_extract(__path,'(?:^|/)([^/]+)\.py$',1) FROM nodes WHERE kind='module' AND NOT rx_matches(__path,'(?:^|/)(?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/'))

stages.name: aliases
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","local","origin" FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.__start,CASE WHEN n.kind='aliased_import' THEN n.alias_source WHEN parent.kind='import_statement' THEN rx_extract(n.text,'^([\w]+)',1) ELSE n.text END AS local,CASE WHEN parent.kind='import_from_statement' THEN trim(parent.module_name_source,'.')||'.'||CASE WHEN n.kind='aliased_import' THEN n.name_source ELSE n.text END ELSE CASE WHEN n.kind='aliased_import' THEN n.name_source ELSE n.text END END AS origin FROM nodes n JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.parent WHERE parent.kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement') AND n.kind IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import') AND n.__start!=coalesce(parent.module_name_start,-1))

stages.name: conditional_classes
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "right_source","id","qualified_name" FROM (WITH latest AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT __path,name,max(__start) AS __start FROM classes GROUP BY __path,name) SELECT c.*,module.qualified||'.'||c.name AS qualified_name,1 AS chosen FROM latest w JOIN classes c ON c.__path=w.__path AND c.name=w.name AND c.__start=w.__start JOIN module_names module ON module.__path=c.__path)

stages.name: class_bases
stages.query: SELECT "__path","cls","name" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.id AS cls,coalesce((SELECT alias.origin FROM aliases alias WHERE alias.__path=c.__path AND alias.local=rx_extract(b.text,'^([\w]+)',1) AND alias.__start<c.__start ORDER BY alias.__start DESC LIMIT 1),rx_extract(b.text,'^([\w]+)',1))||coalesce(rx_extract(b.text,'^[\w]+((?:\.[\w]+)*)',1),'') AS name FROM conditional_classes c JOIN nodes arg ON arg.__path=c.__path AND arg.parent=c.id AND arg.kind='argument_list' JOIN nodes b ON b.__path=arg.__path AND b.parent=arg.id WHERE b.kind IN ('identifier','attribute','call'))

stages.name: derived_conditionals
stages.query: SELECT "name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE derived(name) AS (SELECT 'l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep' UNION SELECT c.qualified_name FROM conditional_classes c JOIN class_bases b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.cls=c.id JOIN derived d ON d.name=b.name) SELECT * FROM derived)

stages.name: conditional_methods
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end","body_start","body_end","body_kind","id","name","cls" FROM (WITH latest AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.__path,own.cls,f.name,max(f.__start) AS __start FROM functions f JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=f.__path AND own.id=f.id JOIN conditional_classes c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.id=own.cls GROUP BY f.__path,own.cls,f.name) SELECT f.*,c.id AS cls,c.name AS class_name,c.qualified_name,1 AS chosen FROM latest w JOIN functions f ON f.__path=w.__path AND f.name=w.name AND f.__start=w.__start JOIN conditional_classes c ON c.__path=w.__path AND c.id=w.cls)

stages.name: conditional_functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "right_source","id","qualified_name" FROM (WITH latest AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.__path,f.name,max(f.__start) AS __start FROM functions f JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=f.__path AND own.id=f.id WHERE own.cls IS NULL GROUP BY f.__path,f.name) SELECT f.*,module.qualified||'.'||f.name AS qualified_name,1 AS chosen FROM latest w JOIN functions f ON f.__path=w.__path AND f.name=w.name AND f.__start=w.__start JOIN module_names module ON module.__path=f.__path)

stages.name: function_colors
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","backend_selection","raises_type_error" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes a ON a.__path=d.__path AND a.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND a.kind='identifier' AND a.text='BackendType') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=d.__path AND a.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND a.attr IN ('backend_type','is_sql_backend','dialect')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes branch ON branch.__path=d.__path AND branch.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND branch.kind IN ('if_statement','elif_clause','conditional_expression','match_statement')) AS backend_selection,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes raised ON raised.__path=d.__path AND raised.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND raised.kind='raise_statement' AND rx_matches(raised.text,'^raise\s+TypeError(?:\s*\(|\s*$)')) AS raises_type_error FROM functions f WHERE f.name='require_sql_physical_conditional' OR f.name='compile_sql_conditional_step' OR f.name='compile' AND rx_matches(f.__path,'(?:^|/)l2070_batching/conditional_step\.py$'))

stages.name: contract_blocks
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start","__end",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_start","id","parent","sequence" FROM (SELECT n.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY n.__path ORDER BY n.__end-n.__start,n.__start) AS sequence FROM nodes n JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id JOIN conditional_methods m ON m.__path=own.__path AND m.id=own.fn WHERE n.kind='block' AND m.name='require_sql_physical_conditional')

stages.name: callable_names
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end","id" FROM (SELECT n.* FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.text='Callable' AND NOT (parent.kind='attribute' AND parent.attribute_start=n.__start) AND NOT (parent.kind IN ('keyword_argument','function_definition','class_definition') AND parent.name_start=n.__start) AND parent.kind NOT IN ('parameters','lambda_parameters','list_splat_pattern','dictionary_splat_pattern'))

stages.name: callable_parameters
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","name" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p.__path,p.fn,p.name FROM parameters p JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=p.__path AND d.root=p.annotation JOIN callable_names atom ON atom.__path=d.__path AND atom.id=d.node)

stages.name: block_results
stages.query: SELECT "__path","state" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE fold(__path,sequence,state) AS (SELECT DISTINCT __path,0,'{}' FROM contract_blocks UNION ALL SELECT b.__path,b.sequence,substr(fold.state,1,length(fold.state)-1)||CASE WHEN length(fold.state)>2 THEN ',' ELSE '' END||json_quote(b.id)||':'||CAST((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes stmt WHERE stmt.__path=b.__path AND stmt.parent=b.id AND stmt.__start<=coalesce((SELECT min(barrier.__start) FROM nodes barrier WHERE barrier.__path=b.__path AND barrier.parent=b.id AND barrier.kind IN ('raise_statement','return_statement')),b.__end) AND (stmt.kind='raise_statement' AND rx_matches(stmt.text,'^raise\s+TypeError(?:\s*\(|\s*$)') OR stmt.kind='if_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes alternative WHERE alternative.__path=stmt.__path AND alternative.parent=stmt.id AND alternative.kind='else_clause') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contract_blocks child WHERE child.__path=stmt.__path AND (child.parent=stmt.id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes arm WHERE arm.__path=child.__path AND arm.id=child.parent AND arm.parent=stmt.id AND arm.kind IN ('elif_clause','else_clause'))) AND coalesce(json_extract(fold.state,'$."'||child.id||'"'),0)!=1) OR stmt.kind='match_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes arm WHERE arm.__path=stmt.__path AND arm.kind='case_clause' AND arm.__start>stmt.__start AND arm.__end<=stmt.__end) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contract_blocks child JOIN nodes arm ON arm.__path=child.__path AND arm.id=child.parent AND arm.kind='case_clause' WHERE arm.__path=stmt.__path AND arm.__start>stmt.__start AND arm.__end<=stmt.__end AND coalesce(json_extract(fold.state,'$."'||child.id||'"'),0)!=1)))) AS TEXT)||'}' FROM fold JOIN contract_blocks b ON b.__path=fold.__path AND b.sequence=fold.sequence+1) SELECT __path,state FROM fold WHERE sequence=(SELECT max(b.sequence) FROM contract_blocks b WHERE b.__path=fold.__path))

stages.name: always_raises

stages.name: integer_returns
